title: OlmoEarth嵌入介绍：从OlmoEarth Studio导出自定义嵌入用于下游分析
summary: 本文介绍了OlmoEarth嵌入功能，该功能允许用户从OlmoEarth Studio导出自定义嵌入，以便进行下游分析。OlmoEarth是一个地理空间基础模型，旨在处理卫星和航空影像等地球观测数据。通过OlmoEarth Studio，用户可以生成针对特定区域或任务的嵌入表示，这些嵌入捕捉了高层次的语义信息，适用于分类、分割、变化检测等多种应用。文章详细说明了嵌入导出的流程、支持的格式（如GeoTIFF）以及如何将嵌入集成到现有的机器学习工作流中。此外，还讨论了嵌入的潜在用途，包括提升模型泛化能力、减少标注需求，并提供了示例代码和资源链接。该功能旨在简化地理空间数据分析，使研究人员和开发者能够更高效地利用预训练模型进行定制化分析。
summary_en: This post introduces OlmoEarth embeddings, a feature that enables users to export custom embeddings from OlmoEarth Studio for downstream analysis. OlmoEarth is a geospatial foundation model designed for Earth observation data such as satellite and aerial imagery. Through OlmoEarth Studio, users can generate embeddings tailored to specific regions or tasks, capturing high-level semantic information useful for classification, segmentation, change detection, and more. The article details the embedding export process, supported formats (e.g., GeoTIFF), and how to integrate embeddings into existing machine learning workflows. It also discusses potential applications, including improving model generalization and reducing annotation requirements, and provides example code and resources. This feature aims to streamline geospatial data analysis, enabling researchers and developers to efficiently leverage pre-trained models for customized analysis.
